title: Accounting for VAT on bad debts when using the VAT margin scheme if you’re a seller
text:
There are special rules to follow if you use the VAT margin scheme and claim VAT relief on bad debts.

 VAT relief you can claim

 If you supply goods and do not receive payment within certain time limits, you may claim relief from VAT on the ‘bad debt’.

 Read full details of the time limits and conditions for claiming in Relief from VAT on bad debts (VAT Notice 700/18) . 

 Guidance on how to deal with bad debts if you’re using a margin scheme is in Paragraphs 5.7 and 5.8 of the notice.  It includes 2 examples to show how it works in practise.

 Under margin schemes, the amount of VAT on which you claim relief on the bad debt cannot be more than the amount of VAT previously accounted for on the margin. 

 VAT returns

 You must show any claims for bad debt relief in your bad debt account and on  your VAT return .
